itthidhutta.cp: masc. one who indulges in women.
itthidhutta.p: [Itthī+dhutta] (pu) CL=8 who is over-indulge in amusement  (or) sensual pleasure with woman, who is enjoyed sexual relations with women who is not his wife; he.

itthidāna.p: [Itthī+dāna] (na) CL=8 offering his wife, wife donation, ( also all people designated the merits, it is really umwholesome in five charities  and it is one of unwholesome charity that is  itthidāna (offering woman).
